This file IS the source document, so `transcribed_from` names its own path: it is the artefact under review, not a transcription of one. Front matter (cover and title page, contents, list of sections, foreword, statement of policy, personnel, correspondence, summary of changes, cross-referencing) and back matter (back cover) were deleted from the drop before supply and are NOT filed; the drop's `content.json`, `index.json`, `meta.json` and `README.md` are retained beside the kind folders, unfiled, for the same reason. The edition — 2025 Edition (ASME BPVC.II.B-2025), issued 2025-07-01 — is stated on the title page, which this drop no longer carries as a filed cut: it survives only inside the retained `content.json`, so no filed cut of this standard prints its own edition. specification.title: Specification for UNS N08028 Seamless Tubes
specification.equivalence_note: Identical with ASTM Specification B668-99 except that certification has been made mandatory.

children.html: (Identical with ASTM Specification B668-99 except that certification has been made mandatory.)
(Identical with ASTM Specification B 668-99 except that certification has been made mandatory.)
1.1 This specification covers UNS N08028 seamless cold-finished tubes intended for general corrosive service. The general requirements are covered in Specification B 829.
1.2 The values stated in inch-pound units are to be regarded as the standard. The values given in parentheses are for information only.
B 829 Specification for General Requirements for Nickel and Nickel Alloy Seamless Pipe and Tube
3.1 Material furnished under this specification shall conform to the applicable requirements of Specification B 829 unless otherwise provided herein.
4.1 Orders for material under this specification shall include the following information:
4.1.1 Alloy name or UNS number,
4.1.2 ASTM designation and year of issue,
4.1.3 Dimensions — Outside diameter, minimum or average wall thickness (in inches or millimetres, not gage number), and length (specific or random),
4.1.4 Quantity (feet or metres, or number of pieces),
4.1.7 Samples for Product (Check) Analysis — State whether samples for product (check) analysis should be furnished, and

4.1.8 Purchaser Inspection — If the purchaser wishes to witness tests or inspection of material at the place of manufacture, the purchase order must so state, indicating which tests or inspections are to be witnessed.
5.1 Tubes shall be made by the seamless process and shall be cold finished.
5.2 Tubes shall be furnished in the solution-annealed condition.
NOTE 1 — The recommended heat treatment shall consist of heating the material to a temperature of 1975 to 2100°F (1080 to 1150°C) with subsequent quenching in water or rapidly cooling by other means.
5.3 The scale shall be removed by suitable means. When bright annealed, scale removal operations are not necessary.
6.1 The material shall conform to the requirement prescribed in Table 1.
Tensile Strength, 0.2% Offset, min, in 2 in. (50.8 mm)
TABLE 3 PERMISSIBLE VARIATIONS IN OUTSIDE DIAMETER AND WALL THICKNESS
6.1.1 A chemical analysis shall be made on each lot of material as described in Specification B 829.
6.2 If a product (check) analysis is performed by the purchaser, the material shall conform to Table 1 subject to the product (check) analysis variations prescribed in Specification B 829.
7.1 The material shall conform to the mechanical properties prescribed in Table 2. One test is required for each lot, as defined in Specification B 829.
7.1.1 One tension test shall be made on each lot of tubes.
7.2 Flaring Test — One flaring test shall be made on a specimen from one end of one tube from each lot of finished tubes.
7.3.1 Each tube shall be subjected to either the hydrostatic test or the nondestructive electric test at the manufacturer's option. The purchaser may specify which test is to be used.
8.1 Outside Diameter and Wall Thickness — The permissible variations in the outside diameter and wall thickness of the tube shall not exceed those prescribed in Table 3.

9.1 A manufacturer's certification shall be furnished to the purchaser stating that the material has been manufactured, tested, and inspected in accordance with this specification, and that the test results on representative samples meet specification requirements. A report of the test results shall be furnished.
